Installing the CLI

The CLI runs on Windows 10 and later. You need .NET 8 installed before you start.

  1. Download the installer from the downloads page.
  2. Run it, then open a new terminal.
  3. Check the version:
folio --version
folio 0.1.0

Options

FlagWhat it does
--quietPrints only errors
--out <dir>Where files are written | default: .

Use folio help for the full list.
